subject: PO drift detected — provisional number assigned but ledger unchanged
messages:
From: Sanjay Mehta <sanjay@cloudworks.com>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 14 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor onboarding — provisional PO issued but not reflected in ledger

Hi Rishi / Monica,

Thanks for the quick onboarding call this morning. Our procurement team (CloudWorks) received a provisional PO number back from your system: 2026-P-45678, which your portal shows as "Issued - provisional." However, our AP team still sees the vendor blocked in the accounting ledger and invoices are not being accepted.

Attached: cloudworks_onboard_form.pdf (vendor onboarding form), ledger-screenshot.png (AP view).

Can you confirm the following?
- Whether 2026-P-45678 was propagated to the finance ledger (GL ingestion).
- If a spend cap is preventing invoice acceptance — our expected monthly cap is $85,000.
- Any missing line-item mapping (we submitted SKU mapping in the onboarding form).

We're blocked on a live invoice for Q3 services; an AP hold is creating a downstream vendor outage. Appreciate a prioritized look.

Best,
Sanjay Mehta
Head of Procurement, CloudWorks
sanjay@cloudworks.com
From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
To: Sanjay Mehta <sanjay@cloudworks.com>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 14 Oct 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding — provisional PO issued but not reflected in ledger

Hi Sanjay — thanks for the details and the attachments (got them).

On Wed, Oct 14, 2026 at 09:12, Sanjay Mehta <sanjay@cloudworks.com> wrote:
> Our procurement team received a provisional PO number... invoices are not being accepted.

Quick status from our side: provisioning shows 2026-P-45678 in the issuance table (provisioning layer) but I do not see a successful ledger write event for that ID. Early hypothesis: the spend cap bucket for that vendor is still at $0.00 which blocks GL ingestion.

Next steps I propose (simple, actionable):
1) Monica to validate provisioning -> ledger mapping and produce a minimal CSV of line-item keys (I attached ponum-mapping.csv).
2) Karthik to raise a FIN ticket for a temporary spend-band bump to allow the current invoice to clear; include accounting approval.
3) I will loop in Laura in Finance for express sign-off.

Sanjay — can you confirm the invoice number and value so we can target the exact spend cap delta? If you can also re-send the vendor billing contact that helps.

I'll mark this high priority and follow up on the ticket.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Sales Ops, Redwood Inference
From: monica_patel@redwood.com
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: Sanjay Mehta <sanjay@cloudworks.com>, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 14 Oct 2026 12:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding — provisional PO issued but not reflected in ledger

Thanks, Rishi. I pulled the provisioning and ledger logs. Summary: provisioning table shows a created record for 2026-P-45678 (timestamp 2026-10-14T08:57Z) with the expected line items. However, the downstream GL ingestion job filtered the record because spend_band_id was null on our side (ingestion rule: spend band must be > 0).

I attached audit-lineitems.xlsx showing the row with empty spend_band and the imported SKU keys — looks like the onboarding form did not map to our spend band taxonomy (S1,S2,S3). CloudWorks submitted a free-text cap request instead of the numeric band.

Proposed immediate remediation:
- I can patch the provisioning row to set spend_band = S2 (maps to $100k cap) if Finance authorizes a temporary exception.
- Alternatively, we can reroute the invoice to a manual approval queue (slower).

Sanjay — can you confirm you authorize a temporary bump to match $85,000? If yes, I'll make the patch and re-run the ingestion.

Attachments: audit-lineitems.xlsx

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Vendor Onboarding Lead, Redwood Inference
From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: Sanjay Mehta <sanjay@cloudworks.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Oct 2026 16:55:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding — provisional PO issued but not reflected in ledger

Thanks everyone for the clear notes. I reviewed Monica's audit and the provisional PO. I authorize a temporary spend_band assignment of S2 for vendor CloudWorks to cover the $85,000 invoice. Finance will perform a manual ledger write once Monica patches the provisioning row.

I've opened FIN-1428 (linked above) and asked accounting to prioritize the ingest. Monica: please ping me once the patch is done and include the invoice reference; I'll confirm the ledger entry and then we can revoke the temporary band if needed.

Sanjay: you should see the ledger accept the invoice within 4 business hours after Monica's patch. Apologies for the friction — we'll add a small change to the onboarding form to make spend band selection explicit (to avoid free-text caps).

Laura Bennett
Director, Finance Operations, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com
